WITH claimed_run AS (
    UPDATE tender_analysis_runs
    SET
        status = 'aggregating',
        aggregation_started_at = COALESCE(
            aggregation_started_at,
            NOW()
        ),
        updated_at = NOW()
    WHERE id = $1::uuid
      AND status = 'ready_for_aggregation'

    RETURNING
        id,
        status,
        documents_total,
        ready_at,
        aggregation_started_at
),

current_run AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        status,
        documents_total,
        ready_at,
        aggregation_started_at
    FROM tender_analysis_runs
    WHERE id = $1::uuid
)

SELECT
    c.id AS analysis_run_id,
    c.status AS run_status,
    c.documents_total,
    c.ready_at,
    c.aggregation_started_at,
    true AS aggregation_claimed
FROM claimed_run AS c

UNION ALL

SELECT
    r.id AS analysis_run_id,
    r.status AS run_status,
    r.documents_total,
    r.ready_at,
    r.aggregation_started_at,
    false AS aggregation_claimed
FROM current_run AS r
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM claimed_run
);

WITH current_run AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        tender_id,
        tender_number,
        tender_external_id,
        status,
        documents_total,
        tender_meta
    FROM tender_analysis_runs
    WHERE id = $1::uuid
),

documents_json AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(
            jsonb_agg(
                jsonb_build_object(
                    'document_id', d.id,
                    'document_index', d.document_index,
                    'file_name', d.file_name,
                    'file_extension', d.file_extension,
                    'display_name', d.display_name,
                    'status', d.status,
                    'units_total', d.units_total,
                    'facts_count', d.facts_count
                )
                ORDER BY d.document_index
            ),
            '[]'::jsonb
        ) AS documents
    FROM tender_analysis_documents AS d
    WHERE d.analysis_run_id = $1::uuid
),

candidate_facts_json AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(
            jsonb_agg(
                jsonb_build_object(
                    'fact_id', f.id,
                    'document_id', f.document_id,
                    'document_index', d.document_index,
                    'file_name', d.file_name,
                    'file_extension', d.file_extension,

                    'analysis_unit_id', f.analysis_unit_id,
                    'fact_index', f.fact_index,

                    'field_catalog_version', f.field_catalog_version,
                    'field_key', f.field_key,
                    'value_text', f.value_text,

                    'extractor_status', f.extractor_status,
                    'extractor_confidence', f.extractor_confidence,
                    'extractor_review_reason_code', f.extractor_review_reason_code,
                    'extractor_review_note', f.extractor_review_note,

                    'validator_verdict', f.validator_verdict,
                    'validator_confidence', f.validator_confidence,
                    'validator_reason_code', f.validator_reason_code,
                    'validator_reason_note', f.validator_reason_note,

                    'evidence', f.evidence
                )
                ORDER BY
                    d.document_index,
                    f.analysis_unit_id,
                    f.fact_index
            ),
            '[]'::jsonb
        ) AS facts
    FROM tender_analysis_facts AS f
    JOIN tender_analysis_documents AS d
        ON d.id = f.document_id
       AND d.analysis_run_id = f.analysis_run_id
    WHERE f.analysis_run_id = $1::uuid
      AND f.validator_verdict IN (
          'confirmed',
          'requires_review'
      )
),

fact_stats AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*)::integer AS facts_total,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE validator_verdict = 'confirmed'
        )::integer AS confirmed_count,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE validator_verdict = 'requires_review'
        )::integer AS requires_review_count,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE validator_verdict = 'rejected'
        )::integer AS rejected_count

    FROM tender_analysis_facts
    WHERE analysis_run_id = $1::uuid
)

SELECT
    r.id AS analysis_run_id,
    r.tender_id,
    r.tender_number,
    r.tender_external_id,
    r.status AS run_status,
    r.documents_total,
    r.tender_meta,

    d.documents,
    f.facts,

    s.facts_total,
    s.confirmed_count,
    s.requires_review_count,
    s.rejected_count,

    jsonb_array_length(f.facts)
        AS aggregation_candidates_count

FROM current_run AS r
CROSS JOIN documents_json AS d
CROSS JOIN candidate_facts_json AS f
CROSS JOIN fact_stats AS s;

INSERT INTO tender_analysis_field_results (
    analysis_run_id,
    field_catalog_version,
    result_contract_version,
    field_index,
    field_key,
    status,
    value_text,
    confidence,
    requires_human_review,
    resolution_method,
    result_json
)
VALUES (
    $1::uuid,
    $2::text,
    $3::text,
    $4::smallint,
    $5::text,
    $6::text,
    $7::text,
    $8::numeric,
    $9::boolean,
    $10::text,
    $11::jsonb
)
ON CONFLICT (analysis_run_id, field_key)
DO UPDATE SET
    field_catalog_version = EXCLUDED.field_catalog_version,
    result_contract_version = EXCLUDED.result_contract_version,
    field_index = EXCLUDED.field_index,
    status = EXCLUDED.status,
    value_text = EXCLUDED.value_text,
    confidence = EXCLUDED.confidence,
    requires_human_review = EXCLUDED.requires_human_review,
    resolution_method = EXCLUDED.resolution_method,
    result_json = EXCLUDED.result_json,
    updated_at = NOW()
RETURNING
  analysis_run_id,
  field_key,
  field_index;
